title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Santiago De La Fuente and Juan Manuel La Serna in the Florianopolis, originally scheduled for November 24, 2026 at 11:30AM ET.
This market will resolve to "Santiago De La Fuente" if Santiago De La Fuente wins by 2 or more sets than Juan Manuel La Serna, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Juan Manuel La Serna."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Santiago De La Fuente can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Juan Manuel La Serna."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by December 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger results.
